53201.meaning1: Detailed Analysis of the Young Man Mettagū's Question; chapter in the Cūḷaniddesa

53202.meaning1: with friendly heart; with kind mind; benevolent

examples.text: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā
tatrā'pi te, phagguna, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na c'eva me cittaṃ vipariṇataṃ bhavissati, na ca pāpikaṃ vācaṃ nicchāressāmi, hit'ānukampī ca viharissāmi mettacitto, na dos'antaro'ti.
yato kho, kassapa, bhikkhu averaṃ abyāpajjaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāveti, āsavānañ'ca khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
yo vā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ antamaso gadduhanamattam'pi mettacittaṃ bhāveyya… idaṃ tato mahapphalataraṃ.

53204.meaning1: fact of having a friendly heart; state of being kind; benevolence

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati? khantiyā, avihiṃsāya, mettacittatāya, anudayatāya, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paraṃ rakkhanto attānaṃ rakkhati.

53205.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of mettacitta

examples.text: kālena ca bhāsitā hoti, saccā ca bhāsitā hoti, saṇhā ca bhāsitā hoti, atthasaṃhitā ca bhāsitā hoti, mettacittena ca bhāsitā hoti.

53211.meaning1: with a portion of friendliness; having a share of benevolence; (comm) (or) with the initial phase of mettā meditation
53211.commentary: (SNa) mett'aṃso'ti so mettañ'c'eva mettāpubbabhāgañ'ca bhāveti. atha vā aṃso'ti koṭṭhāso vuccati. mettā aṃso etassā'ti mett'aṃso.

examples.text: yo na hanti na ghāteti, na jināti na jāpaye, mett'aṃso sabbabhūtānaṃ, veraṃ tassa na kenacī'ti.
mettañ'ca sabbalokasmi, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ, uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyañ'ca, asambādhaṃ averam'asapattaṃ.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, khattiyakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.

53215.commentary: (MNa) mettacittā'ti uppannamettacittā hutvā. (ANa) mettācittan'ti sabbasattānaṃ hitapharaṇacittaṃ. (ANa) mettacittaṃ bhāvesin'ti tikacatukkajjhānikāya mettāya sampayuttaṃ paṇītaṃ katvā cittaṃ bhāvesin'ti dasseti.

examples.text: accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṃ āsevati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro, amoghaṃ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati. ko pana vādo ye naṃ bahulīkarontī'ti!

53216.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of mettacitta

examples.text: codakena, āvuso, bhikkhunā paraṃ codetu'kāmena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā paro codetabbo. kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettācittena vakkhāmi no dos'antarenā'ti.

53217.meaning1: liberation of the mind by friendliness; emancipation of the heart by benevolence
53217.commentary: (ANa) mettā hi kho me cetovimuttī'ti ettha paccanīkadhammehi vimuttattā tikacatukkajjhānikā mettā'va mettācetovimutti nāma.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettācetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
nissaraṇañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, byāpādassa yadidaṃ mettācetovimuttī'ti.

53219.meaning2: highest state of benevolence; perfection of friendliness

53221.meaning1: development of friendliness; cultivation of benevolence; meditation on friendly love

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe mettābhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

rāgacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa asubhakathaṃ katheti, dosacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa mettābhāvanaṃ ācikkhati, mohacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa uddese paripucchāya kālena dhammassavane kālena dhammasākacchāya garusaṃvāse niveseti

53222.meaning1: devoted to the development of friendliness; engaged in the cultivation of benevolence

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe mettābhāvan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.
ekam'pi ce pāṇam'aduṭṭhacitto, mettāyati kusalī tena hoti, sabbe ca pāṇe manas'ānukampī, pahūtamariyo pakaroti puññaṃ.

53229.meaning1: accompanied by goodwill; full of friendliness

examples.text: so mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ.

mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā pasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero tissatthero arogo hotu, app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

53232.meaning1: glossy with the moisture of friendliness

examples.text: mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā suppasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero, tissatthero arogo hotu app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

53237.commentary: (ANa) mettāvatāyā'ti mettāyuttāya pāricariyāya. satta hi sekhā tathāgataṃ mettāvatāya paricaranti, khīṇ'āsavo pariciṇṇasatthuko.

examples.text: nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi, anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchissanti, kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi, satthā ca me pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyā'ti.

53239.meaning1: who is friendly; who is kind; who practises mettā meditation

53240.commentary: (DHPa) mettāvihārī'ti mettākammaṭṭhāne kammaṃ karonto'pi mettāvasena tikacatukkajjhāne nibbattetvā ṭhito'pi mettāvihārī'y'eva nāma. (APAa) sinehalakkhaṇāya mettāya pharitvā viharanti, attabhāvaṃ pavattentī'ti mettāvihārino

examples.text: mettāvihārī yo bhikkhu, pasanno buddhasāsane, adhigacche padaṃ santaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ.

53241.meaning1: living in a state of friendliness; dwelling in kindness; who practices mettā meditation
53241.commentary: (DHPa) mettāvihārī'ti mettākammaṭṭhāne kammaṃ karonto'pi mettāvasena tikacatukkajjhāne nibbattetvā ṭhito'pi mettāvihārī'y'eva nāma. (APAa) sinehalakkhaṇāya mettāya pharitvā viharanti, attabhāvaṃ pavattentī'ti mettāvihārino

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ sāmāvatī.
evaṃ, bhante. sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, brahmā mettāvihārī'ti. taṃ me idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā sakkhidiṭṭho, bhagavā hi, bhante, mettāvihārī'ti.
mettāya phasse tasathāvarānī'ti. mettā'ti yā sattesu metti mettāyanā mettāyitattaṃ anudayā anudayanā anudayitattaṃ hit'esitā anukampā abyāpādo abyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ.

53244.meaning1: names of one of the leaders of the notorious group of six monks
53244.meaning2: name of one of the group of six monks

53245.meaning1: following Mettiya and Bhūmajaka, leaders of the notorious group of six monks
53245.commentary: (VINa) mettiyabhūmajakā'ti mettiyo c'eva bhūmajako ca, chabbaggiyānaṃ aggapurisā ete.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena mettiyabhūmajakā bhikkhū navakā c'eva honti appapuññā ca. yāni saṅghassa lāmakāni sen'āsanāni tāni tesaṃ pāpuṇanti lāmakāni ca bhattāni.

53246.meaning1: name of a mythical future Buddha
53246.meaning2: name of a mythical future Buddha
53246.commentary: (DNa) asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu metteyyo nāma bhagavā loke uppajjissatī'ti na vaḍḍhamānakavasena vuttaṃ. na hi buddhā vaḍḍhamāne āyumhi nibbattanti, hāyamāne pana nibbattanti. tasmā yadā taṃ āyu vaḍḍhitvā asaṅkheyyataṃ patvā puna hāyamānaṃ asītivassasahassakāle ṭhassati, tadā uppajjissatī'ti attho.
53246.notes: Despite the enormous importance given to the future Buddha in later literature, there is only this single questionable reference in the earliest strata of texts.

examples.text: asītivassasahass'āyukesu, bhikkhave, manussesu metteyyo nāma bhagavā loke uppajjissati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.

53249.meaning1: questions of Metteya; sutta in the Pārāyanavagga of the Sutta Nipāta; also known as Tissametteyyamāṇava Pucchā

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

53250.meaning1: name of a mythical future Buddha

examples.text: sattame pārāyane metteyyapañhe'ti pārāyanasamāgamamhi metteyyamāṇavassa pañhe.
api ca m'ettha puggalavemattatā viditā'ti
na hi m'ettha, bhikkhave, abhabbatā vuttā.

assosuṃ kho methileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto, mithilāyaṃ viharati maghadev'ambavane.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno sikkhaṃ appaccakkhāya dubbalyaṃ anāvikatvā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭiseveyya, antamaso tiracchānagatāya'pi, pārājiko hoti asaṃvāso.
virato methunā dhammā, hitvā kāme paropare, aviruddho asāratto, pāṇesu tasathāvare.
pāṇaṃ na haññe na c'adinnam'ādiye, musā na bhāse na ca majjapo siyā, abrahmacariyā virameyya methunā, rattiṃ na bhuñjeyya vikālabhojanaṃ.
disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.
methunadhammo nāma yo so asaddhammo gāmadhammo vasaladhammo duṭṭhullaṃ odak'antikaṃ rahassaṃ dvayaṃdvayasamāpatti, eso methunadhammo nāma.
duṭṭhullā nāma vācā vaccamagga-passāvamagga-methunadhammappaṭisaṃyuttā vācā.

53259.meaning1: expellable offence of sexual intercourse; offence entailing expulsion in regard to sexual activity

examples.text: manussaviggahapārājik'āpatti uttarimanussadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā methunadhamma-pārājik'āpattiyā adinn'ādānapārājik'āpattiyā aññabhāgiyā.

53260.meaning1: related to sexual intercourse; connected with copulation

examples.text: duṭṭhullā nāma vācā vaccamagga-passāvamagga-methunadhammappaṭisaṃyuttā vācā.

53262.meaning1: engaging in sexual intercourse; having sex

examples.text: asubhasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
katamesaṃ dvinnaṃ? methunasamāpattiyā ca vijāyanassa ca. imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ dhammānaṃ atitto appaṭivāno mātugāmo kālaṃ karotī'ti.

53265.meaning1: produced by sex; created by sexual intercourse

examples.text: mānasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo mānaṃ nissāya māno pahātabbo. methunasambhūto ayaṃ, bhagini, kāyo. methune ca setughāto vutto bhagavatā.
āgantukassa bhattaṃ āgantukabhattaṃ, methunā apeto methun'āpeto, corā bhayaṃ corabhayaṃ, rañño putto rājaputto, dhaññānaṃ rāsi dhaññarāsi, rūpe saññā rūpasaññā, saṃsāre dukkhaṃ saṃsāradukkhaṃ.

53269.meaning1: related to sexual intercourse; concerned with sexual activity

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmaṃ duṭṭhullāhi vācāhi obhāseyya yathā taṃ yuvā yuvatiṃ methun'upasaṃhitāhi, saṅgh'ādiseso.
etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.

53270.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: sumbho subho methulo aṭṭhamo ca, ath'assumegho anīgho sudāṭho, paccekabuddhā bhavanettikhīṇā, hiṅgū ca hiṅgo ca mah'ānubhāvā.
atthi imasmiṃ kāye… antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ (matthaluṅgaṃ), pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo, assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan'ti.
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā āpodhātu.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.

53273.meaning1: pot of lard; bowl of fat; cup of drippings
53273.commentary: (ANa) medakathālikan'ti medakathālikā vuccati sūnakārakehi yūsanikkhaman'atthāya tattha tattha katachiddā thālikā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.

53274.meaning1: name of a acrobat; (comm) name of a male acrobat with a female name

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, caṇḍālavaṃsiko caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ ussāpetvā medakathālikaṃ antevāsiṃ āmantesi, ehi tvaṃ, samma medakathālike, caṇḍālavaṃsaṃ abhiruhitvā mama uparikhandhe tiṭṭhāhī'ti.

53276.meaning1: like a lump of fat; fat coloured

examples.text: medavaṇṇaṃ'va pāsāṇaṃ, vāyaso anupariyagā, ap'ettha muduṃ vindema, api assādanā siyā.

53278.commentary: (MNa) medāḷupan'ti nām'etaṃ tassa, tassa hi nigamassa medavaṇṇā pāsāṇā kir'ettha ussannā ahesuṃ, tasmā medāḷupan'ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ. sen'āsanaṃ pan'ettha aniyataṃ, tasmā na taṃ vuttaṃ. (MNt) medavaṇṇā uḷupavaṇṇā ca tattha tattha pāsāṇā ussannā ahesun'ti medāḷupan'ti gāmassa samaññā jātā. uḷupavaṇṇā'ti candasamānavaṇṇatāya medapāsāṇā vuttā'ti keci. aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana medavaṇṇā pāsāṇā kir'ettha ussannā ahesun'ti idaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati medāḷupaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
te imaṃ kāyaṃ balaṃ gāhenti nāma, brūhenti nāma, medenti nāmā'ti.
assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷhaṃ, mahāyaññā mah'ārambhā, na te honti mahapphalā.
pare ca na vijānanti, mayam'ettha yamāmase, ye ca tattha vijānanti, tato sammanti medhagā.
vinicchaye ṭhatvā sayaṃ pamāya, uddhaṃ sa lokasmiṃ vivādam'eti, hitvāna sabbāni vinicchayāni, na medhagaṃ kubbati jantu loke'ti.

53283.meaning1: having wisdom; with intelligence; with discernment

examples.text: pārāyanamanugāyissaṃ, yathāddakkhi tath'ākkhāsi, vimalo bhūrimedhaso, nikkāmo nibbano nāgo, kissa hetu musā bhaṇe.
appamatto pamattesu, suttesu bahujāgaro, abal'assaṃ'va sīgh'asso, hitvā yāti sumedhaso.
bhagavā tāya pathavisamāya paññāya vipulāya vitthatāya samannāgato. medhā vuccati paññā. yā paññā pajānanā… amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.

53285.meaning1: intelligent woman; wise woman; who has good judgement

examples.text: itthī'pi hi ekacciyā, seyyā posa janādhipa, medhāvinī sīlavatī, sassudevā patibbatā.

53286.meaning1: intelligent man; wise man; who has good judgment

examples.text: nidhīnaṃ'va pavattāraṃ, yaṃ passe vajjadassinaṃ, niggayhavādiṃ medhāviṃ, tādisaṃ paṇḍitaṃ bhaje, tādisaṃ bhajamānassa, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
anupubbena medhāvī, thokaṃ thokaṃ khaṇe khaṇe, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.

53287.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.1) merayo nāma pupph'āsavo phal'āsavo madhv'āsavo guḷ'āsavo sambhārasaṃyutto. (VINa) surā nāma piṭṭhakiṇṇapakkhittā, nāḷiker'ādīnam'pi rasena katā surātv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, tassā'y'eva kiṇṇapakkhittāya maṇḍe gahite merayotv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchatī'ti vadanti.

examples.text: surāmerayapāne pācittiyaṃ.
na saṅkittīsu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thus'odakaṃ pivanti.

53288.meaning1: mythical mountain at the centre of the universe
53288.meaning2: name of the highest mountain in the world
53288.commentary: (THIa) meruṃ laṅghetum'icchasi caturāsīti-yojanasahass'ubbedhaṃ sinerupabbatarājaṃ laṅghayitvā aparabhāge ṭhātu'kāmo'si

examples.text: apathena payātum'icchasi, candaṃ kīḷanakaṃ gavesasi, meruṃ laṅghetum'icchasi, yo tvaṃ buddhasutaṃ maggayasi.
me sutan'ti ettha mayā-sadd'attho me-saddo, sotadvāraviññāṇ'attho sutasaddo. tasmā evaṃ me sutan'ti evaṃ mayā sotaviññāṇapubbaṅ'gamāya viññāṇavīthiyā upadhāritan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.
sabbattha te citta vaco kataṃ mayā, bahūsu jātīsu na me'si kopito, ajjhattasambhavo kataññutāya te, dukkhe ciraṃ saṃsaritaṃ tayā kate.
sutavā ca kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako… rūpaṃ n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti samanupassati.
sabbaṃ rūpaṃ, n'etaṃ mama, n'eso'ham'asmi, na m'eso attā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
seyyathā'pi… āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khem'antabhūmiṃ
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yv'āyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ samāpattikusalo ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro cā'ti.
etadaggan'ti etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ seṭṭhaṃ etaṃ mokkhaṃ etaṃ uttamaṃ etaṃ pavaraṃ.
